name: 401(k) Save the Max Calculator
meta_title: 401(k) Save the Max Calculator: Per-Paycheck Amount (2026)
meta_description: Find the per-paycheck dollar amount or percent of pay you need to reach the 2026 401(k) limit, including catch-up, based on what you have contributed so far.
subtitle: Work out how much to put in from each remaining paycheck to reach the 2026 401(k) contribution limit, as a dollar amount and as a percent of pay.

card.fields_html:
Enter your pay and contributions

yrs

Sets your catch-up amount: $8,000 at 50 or older, $11,250 at ages 60 to 63.

$

Gross pay before taxes and deductions, used to turn the dollar amount into a percent.

$

Your own pre-tax and Roth deferrals only, not employer money.

Count only paychecks you can still change.

More options
%

Shows where you would end the year if you change nothing.

$

The limit is per person, so a 401(k) or 403(b) at a job you left this year counts too.
